title: Evans Early American Imprints (Evans-TCP)
notes: Roughly 5,000 transcribed English-language texts (books, pamphlets, broadsides and periodicals printed in America) selected from Readex's Evans Early American Imprints, which covers American imprints from 1639 to 1800. The transcriptions were produced by the Text Creation Partnership (TCP) with Readex (NewsBank) and the American Antiquarian Society; they are encoded as SGML/XML and were released into the public domain under a CC0 dedication, with copies distributed through the University of Michigan Library and the Oxford Text Archive. Access to the Readex page images was withdrawn in 2022; the text files remain available. Corpus statistics (text, word and language counts, period) derived from the Renascor Corpus snapshot v2026.10 (texts harvested from this edition, duplicates included; they may cover only part of it).
